reading: CNN's chief international anchor, Christiane Amanpour, has announced her impending departure from the organisation next year after more than four decades of service.
Following months of contemplation and a few sleepless nights, Amanpour confirmed her intention to separate from the news channel.
Amanpour commenced her tenure in 1983 on the international news desk, subsequently becoming one of the most prominent global reporters.
Throughout her career, she received numerous challenging assignments, extensively covering the horrors of war across regions such as Rwanda, Afghanistan, Ukraine, and Iran.
Furthermore, she has presented her own nightly interview programme on CNN International since 2009.
The 68-year-old media veteran expressed that she eagerly anticipates engaging in new endeavours down the line.
She also emphasised the importance of maintaining an independent approach, reminding her colleagues to always remain truthful rather than strictly neutral.
CNN chairman Mark Thompson lauded her as one of the most trusted and revered media figures anywhere.
Thompson acknowledged his sorrow at her exit but noted that he has come to accept this transition as the right step for her both personally and professionally.
Reflecting on her legacy, Amanpour praised the camaraderie of her teams as they collectively battled to uncover facts and evidence.
She asserted that their unified mission allowed them to transmit the truth to the world, operating entirely without fear nor favour.

vocabulary.definition: Approaching or about to happen in the near future.
The act of leaving or stepping away from an organisation or position.
The act of thinking deeply or meditating on a choice.
Formally began or initiated a professional role or activity.
The period of time during which a person holds a particular job or role.
Important, famous, or highly visible in a particular field.
Serious and continuous attempts or efforts to achieve new goals.
Expressed high praise and admiration for someone's achievements.
Respected and admired deeply by others in the profession.
A feeling of mutual trust, friendship, and solidarity among team members.
Acting in a completely impartial way, refusing to be influenced by threats or special treatment.

entries.ja: 近い将来に差し迫っている、または起ころうとしていること。

entries.zh-Hans: 即将到来或在不久的将来会发生。
entries.es: Que se acerca o está a punto de suceder en un futuro próximo.
entries.pt-BR: Que se aproxima ou está prestes a acontecer em um futuro próximo.
entries.fr: Qui approche ou est sur le point de se produire dans un avenir proche.
entries.de: Bevorstehend oder kurz davor, in naher Zukunft zu geschehen.

entries.ja: 組織や職位を離れる行為、またはそこから身を引くこと。

entries.pt-BR: O ato de sair ou se afastar de uma organização ou cargo.
entries.fr: L'acte de quitter ou de se retirer d'une organisation ou d'un poste.
entries.de: Der Akt des Verlassens oder Zurücktretens von einer Organisation oder Position.

entries.ja: ある選択について深く考えたり、熟考したりする行為。

entries.pt-BR: O ato de pensar profundamente ou meditar sobre uma escolha.
entries.fr: L'acte de penser profondément ou de méditer sur un choix.
entries.de: Der Akt des tiefen Nachdenkens oder Meditierens über eine Entscheidung.

entries.ja: 専門的な役割や活動を正式に開始した、または着手した。
entries.ko: 전문적인 역할이나 활동을 공식적으로 시작하거나 개시한.
entries.zh-Hans: 正式开始或启动一项专业职责或活动。
entries.es: Comenzar o iniciar formalmente un rol o una actividad profesional.
entries.pt-BR: Começou ou iniciou formalmente um papel ou uma atividade profissional.
entries.fr: A commencé ou initié formellement un rôle ou une activité professionnelle.
entries.de: Eine berufliche Rolle oder Aktivität formell begonnen oder eingeleitet.

entries.ja: ある人が特定の仕事や役割を務める期間。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람이 특정 직업이나 역할을 맡는 기간.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个人担任特定工作或职务的时期。
entries.es: El período de tiempo durante el cual una persona ocupa un trabajo o un puesto en particular.
entries.pt-BR: O período de tempo durante o qual uma pessoa ocupa um determinado emprego ou função.
entries.fr: La période de temps pendant laquelle une personne occupe un emploi ou un rôle particulier.
entries.de: Der Zeitraum, in dem eine Person eine bestimmte Stelle oder Rolle innehat.

entries.ja: 特定の分野で重要である、有名である、または非常に目立っていること。
entries.ko: 특정 분야에서 중요하거나, 유명하거나, 매우 눈에 띄는.
entries.zh-Hans: 在特定领域重要、著名或非常引人注目。
entries.es: Importante, famoso o muy visible en un campo en particular.
entries.pt-BR: Importante, famoso ou altamente visível em uma área específica.
entries.fr: Important, célèbre ou très visible dans un domaine particulier.
entries.de: Wichtig, berühmt oder sehr sichtbar in einem bestimmten Bereich.

entries.ja: 新しい目標を達成するための真剣かつ継続的な試みや努力。
entries.ko: 새로운 목표를 달성하기 위한 진지하고 지속적인 시도나 노력.
entries.zh-Hans: 为实现新目标而进行的认真而持续的尝试或努力。
entries.es: Intentos o esfuerzos serios y continuos para lograr nuevas metas.
entries.pt-BR: Tentativas ou esforços sérios e contínuos para alcançar novos objetivos.
entries.fr: Tentatives ou efforts sérieux et continus pour atteindre de nouveaux objectifs.
entries.de: Ernsthafte und kontinuierliche Versuche oder Bemühungen, neue Ziele zu erreichen.

entries.ja: 誰かの功績に対して高い賞賛と感嘆を表明した。
entries.ko: 누군가의 업적에 대해 높은 칭찬과 감탄을 표현한.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某人的成就表达了高度赞扬和钦佩。
entries.es: Expresar grandes elogios y admiración por los logros de alguien.
entries.pt-BR: Expressou grande louvor e admiração pelas conquistas de alguém.
entries.fr: A exprimé de grands éloges et de l'admiration pour les réalisations de quelqu'un.
entries.de: Hohes Lob und Bewunderung für die Leistungen einer Person ausgedrückt.

entries.ja: 専門職の他の人々に深く尊敬され、賞賛されていること。
entries.ko: 직업 내 다른 사람들에게 깊이 존경받고 칭송받는.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到业内其他人深切尊敬和钦佩。
entries.es: Respetado y admirado profundamente por otros en la profesión.
entries.pt-BR: Respeitado e admirado profundamente por outros na profissão.
entries.fr: Profondément respecté et admiré par les autres professionnels.
entries.de: Von anderen in diesem Berufsfeld tief respektiert und bewundert.

entries.ja: チームメンバー間の相互の信頼、友情、連帯感。
entries.ko: 팀원들 간의 상호 신뢰, 우정, 연대감.
entries.zh-Hans: 团队成员之间相互信任、友谊和团结的感觉。
entries.es: Un sentimiento de confianza mutua, amistad y solidaridad entre los miembros de un equipo.
entries.pt-BR: Um sentimento de confiança mútua, amizade e solidariedade entre os membros da equipe.
entries.fr: Un sentiment de confiance mutuelle, d'amitié et de solidarité entre les membres d'une équipe.
entries.de: Ein Gefühl gegenseitigen Vertrauens, Freundschaft und Solidarität unter Teammitgliedern.

entries.ja: 脅威や特別扱いによって影響されることを拒否し、完全に公平な方法で行動すること。
entries.ko: 위협이나 특별 대우에 영향을 받지 않고 완전히 공정한 방식으로 행동하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 以完全公正的方式行事，拒绝受到威胁或特殊待遇的影响。
entries.es: Actuar de manera completamente imparcial, negándose a ser influenciado por amenazas o tratos especiales.
entries.pt-BR: Agir de forma completamente imparcial, recusando-se a ser influenciado por ameaças ou tratamento especial.
entries.fr: Agir de manière totalement impartiale, refusant d'être influencé par des menaces ou un traitement de faveur.
entries.de: Völlig unparteiisch handeln und sich weigern, sich von Drohungen oder Sonderbehandlungen beeinflussen zu lassen.
